latestVersion.changelog:
Vivideo AI Video Generator 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly generate 30-second AI-powered videos from your text scripts and images—no editing skills needed.
- Supports uploading MP4, MOV, JPG, and PNG files up to 200MB for cloud-based video rendering.
- Automatic backend setup and authentication with 100 free credits for new users (7-day validity).
- Seamless export to 1080p MP4; view and manage your credits, status, and uploads.
- Handles smart prompt-to-action routing for exports, uploads, checking credits, and status inquiries.
- Error-handling guides users through authentication, file limits, credits, and export rules.
